title: First Steps: Hunter/Prey Population Dynamics
description: Section 9.6 Lotka-Volterra population patch with hare on OUT X and lynx on OUT Y, defaulting to the booklet roll-mode time trace.

walkthrough.title: Initialize the populations
walkthrough.text: P1 and P2 receive -1 so their outputs provide the inverted IC values needed to start I1 at h0 and I2 at l0.

walkthrough.title: Create the interaction term
walkthrough.text: I1.out and I2.out feed MUL1, which computes the h*l encounter term shared by both Lotka-Volterra equations.

walkthrough.title: Patch the hare equation
walkthrough.text: P3 scales alpha*h. P4 scales beta*h*l and INV1 changes its sign. SUM1 supplies the sign required by the inverting I1 integrator.

walkthrough.title: Patch the lynx equation and display phase space
walkthrough.text: P6 scales delta*h*l. P5 and INV2 form -gamma*l. SUM2 feeds I2, while OUT X/Y expose h and l for either roll traces or X/Y phase plots.
